name: Translocation Cloak
body:
Price 2,800 gp; Aura moderate conjuration; CL 7; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This cloak appears to be a very dark velvet, though the shadows between its folds seem immeasurably vast.

Twice per day as a swift action you can command the cloak to teleport you 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, as though by a dimension door spell, though you may still take actions normally for the rest of your turn.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,400 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, dimension door
